trial_court: XIII Addl. City Civil & Sessions Judge, Mayohall Unit, Bengaluru (CCH-22)
facts_of_case: The plaintiff and defendant were friends who borrowed money from the plaintiff in 2016. The defendant promised to return the loan within a short period but remained silent for four months before voluntarily repaying part of the amount.

legal_principles.principle: A false averment made solely for the purpose of a suit is not acceptable.
legal_principles.held: It is further submitted that in view of the facts narrated above, the averments to the effect that he approached the plaintiff voluntarily and handed over the two cheques described in the plaint with an assurance that the same would be honoured upon presentation is false.

legal_principles.principle: A natural man would not wait for one and half years without issuing a legal notice.
legal_principles.held: It is also denied that a transfer of Rs.5 lakhs was made by the defendant towards part payment of the alleged debt. The averment made in plaint to the effect that he had requested the plaintiff to give him three months time after issuance of notice dated 23/02/2019 is false.

outcome.final_order: The court directed the defendant to pay Rs.37,75,000/- and interest at 18% p.a on Rs.25,00,000/- from the date of suit till realisation.
